title: Reel Adventures Inc
specs: One of the few Miami charters that can take groups up to 24 on one boat
Targets reef, wreck, and offshore species including marlin, swordfish, mahi-mahi
No fishing license needed; boat's license covers all
Guests advised to bring motion sickness medication if needed
Boat licensed and built to carry up to 24 guests
Suitable for family reunions, bachelor parties, corporate events up to 24 people
includes: All gear, bait, tackle, and fishing licenses included
blurb: Guests fish offshore from Haulover Marina on a licensed boat that can carry up to 24 people. Trips range from half day to full day, targeting reef, wreck, and offshore species like grouper, snapper, kingfish, mahi-mahi, tuna, marlin, and swordfish. The crew handles all gear, bait, and rigging; guests fish and enjoy the experience.
extraNote: All cancellations must be in writing by email or text; phone cancellations not accepted · Cancel less than 24 hours before or no-show charged 100% of charter rate · Charters run rain or shine; only cancel for genuinely unsafe weather · Haulover Marina, Miami Beach, FL · Year-round
